name: Ethnan
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Ethnan is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Judah through the lineage of Ashhur. He is known only from his placement in the genealogy and has no further narrative role in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Ethnan is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles as part of the descendants of Ashhur.
